show.description: When an 18-year-old village girl, Meena returns from a Mumbai college trip six months pregnant - with twins fathered by a powerful man, Veer from a “lower caste” - she is brutalized by her family and marked for an honor killing, until the father rescues her and publicly claims her as his wife, forcing a traditional society to confront its own violence, prejudice, and hypocrisy. Watch now!
